responsibility: Declares the coverageinfo module surface for codegen, organizing the LLVM coverage FFI definitions and the function coverage map builder used to emit coverage mapping data.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is a very narrow module root dedicated to coverage codegen, exposing only the LLVM coverage FFI layer and map construction. It is not a general backend namespace, a MIR-lowering state module, a debuginfo helper, or the backend trait interface hub.
